summary: Enterprise Financial Services Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $175 million offering of 6.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes were sold via underwriters Keefe, Bruyette & Woods and Raymond James at a 1.25% discount, yielding ~$172.8M net proceeds. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes including debt repayment, dividends, acquisitions, share repurchases, or regulatory capital contributions to its bank subsidiary. The notes are subordinated, unsecured obligations under a base and first supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction, not a special situation—a routine debt issuance without structural complexity or contest.
